cohort: The study participants were infants born preterm and infants born at term, as characterized by their cord blood and amniotic fluid samples.
finding: Following preterm birth, there is a shift from immunoregulation towards inflammation within cord blood cells, with B cells significantly contributing to this phenomenon.
cross-section timing: At birth (after the onset of preterm birth and at term delivery)
